(2) VideoSecu received a special order from a hospital supply company offering to buy 10,000 wall mounts for $15. If it accepts the order, there will be no additional fixed selling expenses, and there is currently sufficient excess capacity to fill the order. The company’s sales manager argues for rejecting the order because “we are not in the business of paying $19 to make a product to sell for $15.”
